$comment: Who serves each role, as every reader must compute it from one environment of a knowledge base's config. A job type is served by `workers.<type>`, else `workers.default`; an actor by `make-meaning.actors.<actor>`, else `actors.<actor>`, else `make-meaning.default`. TypeScript (packages/core: the loader the worker and the Librarian route work by) and Go (apps/launcher: the roster it writes into the Archivist's configuration document, which `browse:agents` answers from) each run every case and fail on any difference, so the roster names exactly the agents the work is routed to. `config` is the whole file; `roster` is ArchivistConfig's. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

cases.why: no role is bound: no one serves anything

cases.config:
[defaults]
environment = "local"

[environments.local.inference.anthropic]
platform = "external"
apiKey = "k"

[environments.local.inference.ollama]
platform = "external"
baseURL = "http://ollama.internal:11434"

[environments.local.workers.default.inference]
type = "anthropic"
model = "m-default"
